title: Web in-session challenge accept fails: accepter passed as timekeeper
description: apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172 calls createInSessionMatch with timekeeperId: currentAthleteId (the accepter, who is also a competitor in the match). Same RPC validation as jits-9l4 rejects this with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match'. Result: web user clicks Accept on an incoming challenge and silently sees nothing happen (the broadcast challenge_accepted is never sent because the mutation fails first). The original c0b985e fix was meant to enable the timekeeper-live recorder step on web; that step gates on match.timekeeper_id === athlete.id, so dropping the timekeeper id reverts to fighter-live (no recorder). Two viable fixes: (1) drop the timekeeperId assignment and run the recorder on both fighter devices like mobile does, (2) change the BE RPC to allow caller-as-timekeeper. Option 1 is symmetric with the mobile fix and unblocks the demo without a migration. Affects 013 video flow.

title: In-session challenge fails: caller-as-timekeeper rejected by RPC
description: Mobile lobby (apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:75) and web realtime hook (apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:172) pass the calling athlete as timekeeperId to createInSessionMatch. The BE RPC create_session_match (jr_be/supabase/migrations/20260501000000_session_matches_ranked.sql:88-92) explicitly rejects timekeeper_id matching either competitor with 'Timekeeper cannot be a competitor in the match' (HINT invalid_timekeeper). Result: every in-session challenge currently fails with a toast and no match is created. Introduced in c0b985e while trying to enable the 013 video flow on web. Mobile recording is per-device (uploaderAthleteId=me.athlete_id in live-step.tsx) and never needed timekeeper to be set, so removing the assignment on mobile is the right fix. Web's fighter-live vs timekeeper-live routing needs a different approach (e.g. recorder always-on for both fighters, or BE RPC change to allow caller-as-timekeeper). Affects the 013 demo.

title: Mobile video upload retry generates new filename; double-orphan path
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 retries entire uploadRecording on failure, which calls buildMatchVideoStoragePath again with fresh Date.now() -> NEW filename. First failed upload may leave partial object at path A; retry writes path B; upsertMatchVideo UPDATE points at path B. Two orphan paths possible per session. Fix: pass storage path explicitly to retry, or skip path regeneration.

title: Video upload: orphan storage file when DB insert fails
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:91-106 and apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:121-136. Storage PUT succeeds, then upsertMatchVideo throws -> file sits in bucket forever. No supabase.storage.remove() compensation. Web hook surfaces error toast (line 104) but no cleanup. BE has no documented GC. Fix: try { insert } catch { remove storage object }.

title: Mobile video upload uses POST instead of PUT; retry fails with 400
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/upload-recording.ts:99 uses httpMethod='POST' for Supabase Storage. /object/<bucket>/<path> expects POST for create, PUT for upsert. x-upsert: false + POST works on first try, but retry against same path returns 400 'resource already exists'. The retry-once logic in use-video-recorder.ts:88-101 then double-fails. Web SDK .upload() handles this internally.

title: Video upload: videoId lost on unmount mid-upload (orphan file)
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:151-155 and apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:162-169. Cleanup useEffect only stops media tracks; does NOT cancel in-flight upload promise. State setters fire on unmounted component (React warning + videoId lost). If upsertMatchVideo throws after storage PUT succeeded, file is orphaned in match-videos bucket with no DB row.

title: Rules of Hooks violation in MatchFlowWizard
description: apps/mobile/components/match-flow/match-flow-wizard.tsx:69 calls React.useCallback AFTER conditional early returns at lines 59-64. On the render where match first arrives, hook count changes and React throws 'Rendered more hooks than during the previous render.' Fix: move advanceToResult above the early returns. Effort: 1 line.
close_reason: Fixed: moved advanceToResult useCallback above the early returns in match-flow-wizard.tsx so hook order is stable. Verified via npm run typecheck (all 3 workspaces clean).

title: Demo recorder broken: 7/12 scenes target hidden routes
description: Today's demo (alpha build, 2026-05-15) will appear broken. Per CLAUDE.md, /arena, /arena/swipe, /match/*, /messages routes are HIDDEN and redirect to /. Scenes 03,04,06,07,08,09,11 in apps/web/demo/scenes/ navigate to those dead paths and will silently land on / then time out hunting for selectors.

title: useVideoProgress writes rpcMissingRef during render
description: packages/shared/src/hooks/use-video-progress.ts:211. rpcMissingRef.current = rpcMissing runs in render body. Allowed for refs but anti-pattern; move to a useEffect that mirrors rpcMissing state into the ref, or read state directly inside fetchSnapshot.

title: Web video pre-flight size check happens after recording
description: apps/web/hooks/use-video-recorder.ts:59-63. MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES check is inside upload(), not startRecording(). User records for 10 min then learns blob too big. Mobile has pre-flight getInfoAsync check (line 87-94). Parity drift. Estimate bitrate * duration at start, or warn user near limit.

title: useVideoProgress useEffect re-subscribes on every fetch
description: packages/shared/src/hooks/use-video-progress.ts:277-310. Dep array includes fetchSnapshot and scheduleRefresh useCallbacks. They're memoized on supabase + videoId, so stable in well-behaved callers (VideoAnalysisViewer:122 useMemo's the client). But any caller passing a non-memoized supabase tears down and rebuilds the channel on every render. Remove fetchSnapshot/scheduleRefresh from deps (already version-gated via versionRef).

title: useVideoProgress rpcMissing is sticky; degraded mode never recovers
description: packages/shared/src/hooks/use-video-progress.ts:233-234. Once setRpcMissing(true) fires (e.g. during a deploy gap), hook never re-tries the RPC for the rest of the session. After BE deploys, UI stays in 'Realtime-only' fallback mode until full reload. Fix: reset on videoId change or on refresh() call.

title: upsertMatchVideo UPDATE clears optional columns on conflict retry
description: packages/shared/src/api/mutations.ts:691-701. On 23505 (duplicate key) retry path, UPDATE explicitly sets duration_seconds, camera_angle, athlete_left_id, recorded_by, recording_type to null if caller did not pass them. So a second upload that omits recordingType clears the original recordingType='self'. Fix: use COALESCE/?? against current row, or omit unset fields from UPDATE payload.

title: Video mutations throw instead of returning Result<T> (Principle 4 violation)
description: packages/shared/src/api/mutations.ts:608-715. createMatchVideo and upsertMatchVideo throw on failure. Every other mutation in this file returns Result<T> per CLAUDE.md Principle 4 (createChallenge, recordMatchResult, etc.). Callers (upload-recording.ts:129, use-video-recorder.ts:92) wrap in try/catch as workaround. Inconsistent error-handling shape; refactor to Result<T>.

title: useSessionLobbyRealtime sends stale athlete name/elo in challenge payload
description: apps/web/hooks/use-session-lobby-realtime.ts:28-33. currentAthleteName/currentAthleteElo feed sendChallenge (line 160) but the realtime useEffect (line 50) only depends on sessionId, router. If the user renames mid-session, outgoing challenge_sent payload uses stale name. Stash in refs (same pattern as meRef on line 41). Effort: 3 lines.

title: getNotificationPreferences silently swallows errors
description: packages/shared/src/api/mutations.ts:807-820 — only non-Result<T> read in mutations.ts. On RLS failure returns defaults indistinguishable from 'no row'. Either move to queries.ts and return Result<NotificationPrefs>, or at minimum log the error.

title: useMatchCompletion cleanup gap on terminal->non-terminal transition
description: apps/mobile/lib/match-flow/use-match-completion.ts:49-54 only returns a cleanup when matchStatus is terminal. If matchStatus transitions terminal->non-terminal (e.g. after refresh() resets state), the stale timer fires onCompleted against a now-active match. Add an else early-return or always-return cleanup. Effort: 2 lines.

title: Demo recorder crashes mid-run if videoA.saveAs throws
description: apps/web/demo/record.ts:185-198. videoA.saveAs() has no try/catch. On disk-full or flush race, loop crashes mid-run and remaining scenes leak browser contexts. Wrap saveAs in try/catch and continue.

title: Lobby uses router.replace for onMatchStarted — no back-nav on stray broadcast
description: apps/mobile/app/(app)/session/[id]/lobby.tsx:47,84,98 swapped router.push to router.replace. Any stray onMatchStarted broadcast pops the user out of the lobby with no return path. Recommend keeping push for the realtime onMatchStarted callback at minimum.
notes: RE-EVAL 2026-05-15: Commit 2c3fba2 kept router.replace in BOTH local (lines 84, 98) and realtime (line 47) paths. Local paths intentional per commit msg (back-gesture goes to session list). Scope reduced: realtime onMatchStarted at line 47 still pops user out on stray broadcast with no guard distinguishing self-initiated vs other participants. Fix: either gate on whether currentAthleteId is in started_match.participants, or restore push for that callback only.

title: Mobile signup copy contradicts Supabase email-confirmation flow
description: apps/mobile/app/(auth)/signup.tsx:48,128-132 — success toast now says 'Account created' and card says 'Sign in to set up your profile'. But apps/mobile/lib/auth/auth-context.tsx:90 calls supabase.auth.signUp with no emailRedirectTo and no auto-confirm. Unless email confirmation is disabled in Supabase dashboard, sign-in will fail with 'Email not confirmed' and there is no resend affordance. Either disable confirmation in Supabase or restore 'Check your email to confirm' copy.
notes: RE-EVAL 2026-05-15: Commit 2c3fba2 only changed copy. auth-context.tsx:90 still calls supabase.auth.signUp with no emailRedirectTo. signup.tsx:42-49 ignores data.user.confirmed_at. No env var, doc, or .env.example references auto-confirm policy. Needs (a) document Supabase 'Confirm email=off' in docs/ and .env.example, OR (b) detect confirmed_at===null and show a 'check your email' card instead.
close_reason: Fixed: signUp now returns needsEmailConfirmation flag based on whether Supabase returned a session. Signup screen shows contextual copy (Check your email vs Account created). Also added emailRedirectTo: elorated://login so confirmation links route back into the app.

title: Demo: withTimeout leaks underlying Playwright work on timeout
description: apps/web/demo/record.ts:45-53. setTimeout rejection wins the race, but scene.run keeps executing (Playwright actions cannot be cancelled). Next scene's ctxA.close() may race with in-flight clicks from the prior scene -> unpredictable failures, ghost console errors, hung uploads.

title: Web login page missing email/password sign-in
description: The /login page only offers 'Register with Email', 'Sign in with Google', 'Sign in with Apple', and 'Forgot password?'. There's no way for existing users to sign in with email/password — they have to use Google/Apple SSO or reset their password. Discovered while testing the match flow with two fresh test users created via /signup.

title: Remove dead recordPromiseRef in mobile video recorder
description: apps/mobile/lib/video/use-video-recorder.ts:69, 123, 139. recordPromiseRef is assigned and cleared but never read. Either await it for cancellation safety, or delete.

title: useVideoProgress silently keeps stale data on missing row
description: packages/shared/src/hooks/use-video-progress.ts:106 + 243-247. fetchVideoProgressViaTables returns null on RLS lag or just-inserted-not-yet-readable race; fetchSnapshot only setData if snapshot is truthy. On transient absence the hook silently keeps stale data with no error indication. User sees old data. Fix: setError or setData(null) explicitly on transient miss.

title: Add tests for useVideoProgress hook
description: packages/shared/src/hooks/use-video-progress.ts has zero test coverage. Missing: realtime channel teardown on videoId change, debounce-timer cleanup on unmount, rpcMissing fallback, empty-chunks edge case, fetchVideoProgressViaTables null-on-missing-row. Pairs with match-video.test.ts which only covers the mutation layer.

title: Audit unsafe 'as unknown as' casts in queries.ts (14 sites)
description: packages/shared/src/api/queries.ts has 14 'as unknown as' sites. Lines 387-388, 967-969, 1202, 1233 cast aliased FK joins (challenger:athletes!fk(...)) through unknown — but per CLAUDE.md Principle 3, aliased joins return T directly. Removing the casts would surface latent shape mismatches.

title: Move formatElapsed and parseFinishTime to @jits/shared/utils
description: Mobile has tested implementations at apps/mobile/lib/match-flow/format-elapsed.ts and parse-finish-time.ts; the web match wizard re-implements the same mm:ss formatting inline. Tests can move with the source.

title: Unify haversineKm distance helpers across web/mobile
description: apps/web/app/(app)/session/[id]/join/steps/geo-check-step.tsx:16-26 ships an atan2-based impl; apps/mobile/lib/location/use-location.ts:65-79 ships an asin-based one. Same result but divergence is a future bug. Extract to packages/shared/src/utils/geo.ts plus GYM_PROXIMITY_THRESHOLD_KM.

title: Extract weight-validation constants to @jits/shared/utils
description: Duplicated in 4 sites: apps/web/app/(app)/session/[id]/join/steps/weight-confirm-step.tsx:17, apps/web/app/profile/setup/steps/training-step.tsx:25, apps/mobile/lib/session/validate-weight.ts:7-8, apps/mobile/lib/profile-setup/validation.ts:38-40. MIN_WEIGHT_LBS=50 / MAX_WEIGHT_LBS=400. Shared isValidWeight + constants removes drift risk.

title: README still uses JITS branding — stale
description: README.md:1,3,7,8,11,98,102 says 'JITS', jits:// scheme, jits.app universal links, and lists Beta Launch Status (2026-04-27). App is now ELO RATED, scheme elorated://, domain elorated.com (per CLAUDE.md). Phases 6/9/10 shipped 2026-05-06. Misleading for demo viewers.
